description: Machine-readable checkpoint for signed upload authorization, presigned PUT, exact object-version verification and scan enqueue over ephemeral PostgreSQL 16 and MinIO. This is local integration evidence, not production capacity evidence.

scenarios.route: POST authorization -> presigned PUT -> POST complete
scenarios.successCriteria: all 32 complete upload lifecycles finish with HTTP 202, with no transport or 5xx failures
scenarios.integrityCriteria: 32 consumed authorizations and 32 scan_pending quarantine rows exist with 32 distinct object keys and exact version ids

readiness.note: This closes the object-store-not-measured blind spot only for an ephemeral MinIO integration harness. Production TLS, scoped credentials, retention/lifecycle, soak, saturation and production-equivalent evidence remain missing.
